text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that the Umamusume Racing Museum had been renovated,
I took Zenno Rob Roy along for a visit.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume who dedicated their lives to racing...
The hoofprints of their great achievements are right here."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The stories of the pioneers who left their names in racing history.
Confronting them is like reliving the battles themselves...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. That's why today,
I'm wearing my very special outfit...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: When approaching such a great story, one must not be lacking in courtesy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Let us go, Trainer.
To unravel the memories of that fierce battle of the past.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What I lack. I know I can find whatever it is
I need to bring me closer to true strength!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "At each exhibition booth, AR displays utilizing archival video and imagery recreated the races from back then."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
An exhibition for the Tenno Sho (Autumn) at Nakayama Racecourse...
Which means, this is from last year's...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san's victory interview footage!
Even watching it now, she looks so dignified...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This is the Classic Campaign exhibit area!
That dead heat between Gimlet and Kris S... I'll never forget it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: If only I could race No Reason-san and Hishi Miracle-san someday... Someday.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The stories of those who raced against Kris S-san
feel just like pages from the heroic tales I adore so much...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: If only I had the strength those girls have...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Incredible... To think that the records from the generation Kris S-san fought through alone could amount to this much...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I realized that as I am now...
I won't be able to catch up.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The radiance born of the strength they displayed is dazzling...
Fighting on equal terms with the older generation... and even seizing victory.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The more race scenes I watch... the more I realize. I'm not capable of spinning a story like this.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Just looking at her running style, that way of competing... there's no way I could ever imitate it..."
choice_data_list: There's no need to copy anyone.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: I didn't come here to learn how our predecessors fought.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought Zenno Rob Roy here because I wanted her to feel the spirit
and dedication of her predecessors. I tell her we didn't come here
to measure the gap between them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: If you want to face it, you have to keep moving forward.
If you want to face it, you have to keep moving forward, you know.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...That's true.
Even though that's why I wore these clothes."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The sky, the moon, the stars. Embroidery representing the vast world stretching beyond... A beacon broadening my potential.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It is a precious outfit that lets me feel the hopes of everyone who believes in my potential.
I almost forgot that.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Merely chasing from behind won't allow us to truly face each other.
I will step forward and explore the possibilities that lie ahead.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I am me... Not the predecessors recorded here,
nor their rivals.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Besides, even if we were to meticulously recreate their story—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Because at that point, it would no longer be
'Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale.'"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Learning passion and resolve from the tales of my predecessors... What I will write next is my own story.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's weave it together with your own two hands!
Yeah, let's weave it with your own hands!
Then we know what we have to do.
Then we know what we have to do.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Learning passion and resolve from the tales of my predecessors... What I will write next is my own story.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's weave it together with your own two hands!
Yeah, let's weave it with your own hands!
Then we know what we have to do.
Then we know what we have to do.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Everything I felt from the stories written here...
One day, I'll weave it into my own story... with my own hands!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With renewed determination,
Zenno Rob Roy gazed toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I can see the plotline leading toward the goal.
For now, I'll reliably do what I can.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To overcome each and every battle right before my eyes.
I'll give it my all to become the best version of myself I can be right now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the grand battle waiting at the end of the envisioned path,
they took their steps forward, one by one.
